name: interlace
description: Media box API behind Incandenza's TV page

scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.lint:backend:fix: cd backend && uv run ruff check --fix .
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && uv run python -m pytest tests/ -v
scripts.ci: npm run lint:backend && npm run test:backend
scripts.restart: npm run doctor && systemctl --user restart aria2.service interlace.service interlace-kodi-desktop.service
